text:
deploy-bot: staged-rollout started for service="inference-api" image="v3.2.0" traffic=10% (us-east1=3%, eu-west=7%, ap-south=0%). change_window=2026-03-20T20:00Z-23:00Z. To pause: `redwoodctl rollout pause --service inference-api`

alex: seeing a spike in 502/5xx from eu-west right after the shift to v3.2.0, started ~1768004340. graphs -> https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd/rollouts?view=eu-west :point_up:

priya: copying the grafana panels — good catch. Can we hold any further percent increases?

morgan: yes please hold. do not advance past 10% globally until we triage the eu-west signal. Can someone pin the region to the previous version while we investigate?

sam: on it. pinning eu-west to v3.1.9 now. command:
```
redwoodctl rollout pin --service inference-api --region eu-west --version v3.1.9 --reason "observed 5xx after v3.2.0 shift"
```

sam: deploy-bot shows config applied, awaiting traffic reconciliation.

deploy-bot: pin applied: inference-api eu-west -> v3.1.9. traffic reconciled to previous weights. rollout paused. status: eu-west reverted, global remains at 3% us-east1 / 0% ap-south / eu-west pinned.

lina: looking at the logs: the 502s correspond to OOMs in the attention kernel when sequence > 2048 after quantization path for v3.2.0. snippet:
```
[2026-03-20T20:05:12Z] inference-worker-27: ERROR oom: kv_cache_alloc failed for seq=2304 kernel=quant_fused_attn
[stack] rollout: v3.2.0
```

priya: hmm — that matches the perf regression we saw in the perf-runner tests on long-context prompts but it didn't fail in the short-context unit sets. release notes need to be updated to call out "quantization kernel changes may regress long-context stability". I'll add a note and flag for a patch.

alex: propose stop/go call: hold for 15 minutes to confirm no residual 5xx, then either revert globally or re-run a 1% eu-west canary with kernel fallback. opinions?

morgan: agree with the 15m observe. timeline: T+15m observe, if 5xx <= baseline then proceed to limited 1% canary in eu-west with `ATTN_KERNEL=fallback` env override; else full rollback of v3.2.0.

sam: volunteered to own the rollback if needed. 

priya: noted change window still open until 23:00Z. prefer to avoid a global rollback in-window unless we hit customer-impact thresholds. favor targeted rollback/pin.

alex: @morgan please call stop/go at T+15. I'll keep monitoring dashboards and customer-reported errors.

morgan: stop/go check at 20:16Z — metrics trending down after pin, 5xx rate back to baseline in eu-west, latency normalized. decision: HOLD on global rollout, DO NOT progress to >10% until kernel fallback patch lands and e2e long-context smoke passes.

deploy-bot: rollout status update: paused. eu-west pinned to v3.1.9. global traffic unchanged. changelog tag updated: "v3.2.0 paused - long-context kernel regression (investigating)".

sam: adding follow-ups — create ticket with priority P1: "v3.2.0 attention kernel OOM on long contexts" and add owners @infra-ml and @runtime. I'll attach logs and repro.

lina: quick repro command shared in ticket: `python repro_long_context.py --model v3.2.0 --seq 2304 --batch 1` — reproduces OOM consistently on our test harness.

priya: I'll update the release notes and PR to include the advisory and mark the feature as opt-in until we patch. tagging docs and security review.

alex: thanks everyone. summary: hold rollout, eu-west pinned to v3.1.9, do not advance until patch + smoke tests. sam owns rollback path, morgan owns decision gate, priya updates release notes.

deploy-bot: thread closed by action: rollout paused and region pinned. next_updates: ticket #RI-3247.
